segments.ja80:1.1: Yaṃ te pavikatthitaṃ pure, atha te pūtisarā sajanti pacchā;
segments.ja80:1.3: Ubhayaṃ na sameti bhīmasena, yuddhakathā ca idañca te vihaññanti.
segments.ja80:4.1: Varuṇā akataññūvare tu saccavaraṃ, savanappatinā ca abhitthanaya;
segments.ja80:4.3: Karuṇāya silāplava illisato, puna ḍiṇḍimapūtisarena dasāti.
